app_store.name: QuarryFind: OSINT Search
app_store.subtitle: Usernames, emails, domains
app_store.promotional_text: Every source is checked daily against a real account and a made-up one, and every result says why it counts.
app_store.description:
QuarryFind checks a username, email address or domain against 320 public sources at once and shows what each one returns, live.

Built to be checked, not trusted:
- Every result says why it counts: an official API, a profile marker, or the site's own not-found answer.
- Sources are tested every day against a real account and a made-up name. Ones that get it wrong are switched off, and the live status of every source is public.
- A source that blocks us or times out is listed as didn't answer, never as no account.
- Spot a wrong result? Report it and the source is re-checked.

What else is in it:
- Domain search: WHOIS, DNS, mail security, subdomains, archive history, web stack.
- Email search from public signals only.
- Cases to keep findings with your notes, and CSV or JSON export.
- 15 focused tools, including IP lookup, photo metadata and email header analysis.
- A free API with streamed results.

Free. No plans and no credits. Public sources only: no CAPTCHA solving, no logging in as anyone, no database of people. Use it only for investigations you are allowed to run.
app_store.whats_new: Report a wrong result from any card. Reports show on the public source status page.
